note: S240 /goal arc verified every premise against live code and source files. The session shipped startup truth fixes, secrets/probe gateway hardening, Worker stream-clone hardening beyond nonce mode, stale genius-list suppression, and Ark cargo for sibling compliance. INP root-fix, public voice, push notification dispatch, and ARK_HMAC_SEED provisioning remain honest deferrals because source data or founder-gated authority is absent.

items.title: Resolve capability maps from the sibling Studio Ops secrets gateway
items.why: Startup reported 0/0 ready capabilities because local env files could merge from Studio Ops while the capability map lookup only checked this repo. That created false unblock/blocker signals and weakened CANON-019 try-first discipline.
items.recipe: Teach scripts/lib/secrets.mjs to discover the reachable Studio Ops CAPABILITY_MAP.json when no local map exists, then verify a real capability lookup without printing secrets.
evidence: node scripts/check-secrets.mjs --for claude.api --json EXIT 0 returned ok true with required key names only
node scripts/check-secrets.mjs --json EXIT 0 now reports real ready/missing capabilities instead of 0/0

items.title: Fail startup smoke when a known capability resolves as 0/0
items.why: The startup smoke suite could SKIP gateway-readiness even when a reachable capability map defined claude.api. That let a broken capability resolver masquerade as absence of configured credentials.
items.recipe: Parse the reachable capability map inside smoke-startup-scripts.mjs and turn a known 0/0 result into a failure instead of a skip.
evidence: node scripts/smoke-startup-scripts.mjs EXIT 0: 30/30 checks passed including gateway-readiness claude.api

items.title: Let provider probes read sibling capability maps without mutating them
items.why: probe-capability skipped live probes when this public repo lacked secrets/CAPABILITY_MAP.json, even though Studio Ops had the canonical map. Probes also must not write sibling secrets files from this repo.
items.recipe: Resolve the sibling map for reads, stamp lastProbe fields only when the map is local, and append live probe telemetry to this repo's portfolio ops ledger.
evidence: node scripts/probe-capability.mjs --for claude.api EXIT 0 returned HTTP 200
portfolio/ops/capability-probes.ndjson records S240 claude.api probe rows

items.title: Render an honest empty HUMAN PRESSURE block in startup briefs
items.why: Brief validation flagged the recommended HUMAN PRESSURE block as missing when there were no pressure items. Missing empty-state UI made a healthy no-pressure state look like a format defect.
items.recipe: Always render HUMAN PRESSURE with none/0/continue values when there is no founder-action pressure.
evidence: node scripts/validate-brief-format.mjs docs/STARTUP_BRIEF.md --json EXIT 0 with no missing required or recommended blocks

items.title: Stop the genius list from re-promoting resolved historical carries
items.why: The hit list kept surfacing items that later sessions had already completed or intentionally rejected, including OG coverage, proof-feed parity, VideoGame JSON-LD, workflow cache lint, Lighthouse trend auto-update, and old CI verify carries.
items.recipe: Add done-evidence suppression, canonical duplicate keys, fresh ci-status.json preference, and source-of-truth checks for Lighthouse trend and scheduled workflow staleness artifacts.
evidence: .cache/genius-list.json now reports ciHealth all-green and no longer promotes resolved OG/proof/VideoGame/workflow-cache/old-CI carries

items.title: Buffer generic HTML before multi-clone cache writes in the Worker
items.why: S239 fixed the nonce HTMLRewriter stream clone deadlock, but HTML could still bypass nonce mode and reach the primary/DR cache clone path as a live streaming Response.
items.recipe: For all isHtml responses outside nonce mode, materialize upstream.arrayBuffer() before wrapping with security headers and cache writes.
evidence: node scripts/check-worker-rewriter-safety.mjs EXIT 0: HTMLRewriter and generic HTML cache paths buffered

items.title: Extend the Worker safety gate to detect generic HTML stream clone regressions
items.why: The existing gate only checked HTMLRewriter.transform(). A future refactor could keep nonce mode safe while accidentally sending plain HTML streams into multi-clone cache writes.
items.recipe: Add scanForMissingGenericHtmlBuffer() and self-tests that fail when the generic else-if(isHtml) branch is missing or does not call upstream.arrayBuffer().

items.title: Ship sibling CANON-006 compliance follow-up through Ark instead of editing sibling repos
items.why: The hit list carried sibling compliance work, but CANON-018 forbids this repo from directly writing sibling trees. The correct action is cargo to the owning Studio Ops control plane.
items.recipe: Ship repo-question cargo to studio-ops with the stale carry and sibling compliance context.
evidence: node scripts/ark.mjs ship --type repo-question --to studio-ops EXIT 0
